integrity: Complete theoretical proof plus finite, independently reproducible standard-library checks. All originality claims limited to the weighted Boolean-product majorization, dimension law, and two-rate singular boundary; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Coordinate-homogeneous nonnegative rates and the completed linear implicit-trapezoidal heat step only; no assertion about arbitrary edgewise rate designs, nonlinear stages, stability/error, or independent audit. Generic Markov-chain resolvent positivity is previously known.
title: Majorization and dimension laws for Crank–Nicolson positivity on weighted Boolean cubes
